reader_response.answer:
Leadership should approve the four-week pickup redesign test and reserve up to $9,000 for Cedar and Maple. Cedar can start when ready; Maple can join only after staffing clears, and no clearance date is confirmed. If leadership defers funding, it should keep the current counter flow.

At Cedar, pickups over 10 minutes fell from 18 of 120 before the trial (15.0%) to 7 of 118 during the two-week trial (5.9%), a decrease of 9.1 percentage points. This establishes an observed before-and-during difference at one site; without a control, it does not establish that the redesign caused the decrease.

At the end of the test, leadership should compare the share of pickups over 10 minutes by site before deciding on expansion. The artifact does not specify an expansion threshold or other decision criteria.
